description: Open roles on one company's public Teamtailor career site, read from its jobs.rss feed (pass the subdomain, e.g. career for career.teamtailor.com). Title, city, country, department, role, remote status, publish time, link. Salary is not in the feed; one company per call. Related tools on this server, for a different need: jobs_workday when you need open roles on one company's public Workday career site; jobs_ashby when you need open roles from one company's public Ashby job board. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
